<div class="card-body">
'''Tatooine: Dune Sea''' is a [[Light]] [[Location]] ([[Site]]) from [[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)|Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">タトゥイーン：大砂原</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
'''Dark Side:''' <span lang="ja">戦闘運命数を引くのに必要な能力値が６以上になる。</span><ref name="jp1-face">Japanese text as on the [[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-130o-Face.jpg|Japanese Premiere printed face]] of [[Tatooine: Dune Sea (Japanese)]]; checked line by line against this Two-Player face, which prints the same text.</ref>
<ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-Two-Player-Tatooine-Dune-Sea-SWCCGcards.jpg|This Two-Player printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Tatooine: Dune Sea.

'''Dark Side:''' The ability required to draw battle destiny increases to 6 or more.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Japanese raises the ability needed to draw battle destiny to 6 or more; English requires total ability of 6 or more for you.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Tatooine: Dune Sea]] in [[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 44, 105. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
